scope: Read-only comparison of retained bridge-portability outputs and spatial-v8 evidence against the selected provider closure. No provider selection is changed.

bridge_portability_v1.reason_for_status: The retained v1 script reached PAQ and JXL installs, then failed while configuring its spatial step; its artifact map was therefore not finalized.

paq_source_identity.evidence: Each selected PAQ bridge has a retained local source root, a README hash, and a per-file source receipt listed in provider-provenance-v3.json. Those records identify the staged source bytes without requiring an upstream revision.
paq_source_identity.limit: The v1 rebuilt PAQ shared objects are not byte-identical to the selected shared objects. The retained receipts do not establish a byte-reproducible selected PAQ binary build; they establish reproducible source inputs.

build_and_install.install_transform: The retained cmake_install.cmake records an RPATH change from the build artifact to $ORIGIN; both files retain Build ID a465aa650d7c14bba3635f4c47959c8b8e2e5a4c.

spatial_selected_binary_binding.current_source_limit: The current spatial CMakeLists.txt has a different hash from the retained v8 snapshot. bridge-portability-v2 therefore produced 5d9c067693d24e02d751469789a2e70c072c1d99af9ef25bd6d7fb73c48bf09e, which is recorded as a different rebuild rather than substituted for the selected binary.

non_claim: This evidence does not change the selected closure, establish legal compliance, or make the selected PAQ binaries byte-reproducible.
